name: airfoil_cst_rans_mlp
description: Ensemble of 5 MLPs (8 -> 96 -> 96 -> 96 -> 3, SiLU, bootstrap) mapping a 6-weight CST airfoil and the angle of attack to lift, drag and quarter-chord moment coefficients of a fully turbulent, incompressible 2-D RANS solution at Re = 4e6. The ensemble spread is returned as an uncertainty.
task: Airfoil aerodynamic coefficients (Cl, Cd, Cm) from shape and angle of attack, 2-D steady RANS

validity_range.geometry_family: 2nd-order Bernstein CST, upper = M + T, lower = M - T, trailing-edge thickness 0.25 % chord
validity_range.regime: fully turbulent (k-omega SST), attached to mildly separated; deep stall (Cl swing > 0.1 over the last 500 iterations) was excluded from training

known_limitations: Drag at high lift reads ~14 % high on the campaign grid (20k cells) compared with finer grids/XFOIL; the surrogate inherits the solver's bias, it does not correct it.
Not valid in deep stall, at other Reynolds numbers, compressible flow or outside the CST bounds.
Accuracy is against the same solver and grid that generated the training data (interpolation error); the solver's own error against experiment is the larger term.
equations: steady incompressible RANS, k-omega SST (OpenFOAM v1912 simpleFoam)

training_config.loss: MSE on standardised (Cl, log Cd, Cm), weights (1, 2, 1)

data_lineage.split: by shape (seed 3, 15 % of LHS shapes held out)

reference_source: Held-out OpenFOAM RANS runs on 15 airfoil shapes never seen in training (60 runs) and 36 NACA 0012/2412/4412/4415 runs excluded from training. The solver is verified: 3-grid study on NACA 2412 at alpha 4 deg (Cd GCI 1.9 %, observed order 2.4; Cl within 0.02 %), XFOIL 6.99 tripped (Cl -2.3 %, Cd +4.5 %), lift slope 0.110/deg vs 0.110/deg thin-airfoil theory, NASA TMR NACA 0012 SST (Cd 0.00812 vs 0.0081).
citation: PINNeAPPle contributors (2026). Airfoil RANS campaign (OpenFOAM v1912 simpleFoam, k-omega SST, Re 4e6, 436 runs) and MLP-ensemble surrogate. PINNeAPPle model zoo, https://github.com/PINNeAPPle-Labs/PINNeAPPle
